intro.description: A Curriculum Inventory report describes a program for one reporting period: its academic levels, its events (sessions, assessments), the sequence blocks (courses, clerkships, phases) that organize them, and the competency objects they address. This cheat sheet builds a report in that order and checks it before submission.

item.title: Create the report
item.description: Create a document of the type Curriculum Inventory (the 2022 "v10" point release unless your recipient asks for 1.0). Enter the report ID and the reporting period on the Report page, and the institution and program on Institution and Program.

item.title: Describe the academic levels
item.description: On the Academic Levels page, add one level per year or phase and set Levels in program to their number. Sequence blocks refer to the levels by number.

item.title: Add the events
item.description: On the Events page, add each instructional or assessment event with an id, a title, its duration and its methods (the standardized vocabulary is offered). Give each event an id: blocks refer to events by it.

item.title: Organize the events in sequence blocks
item.description: On the Sequence page, add the blocks (courses, clerkships) with their dates and levels. In Events of the block, choose the events from the list instead of typing references. Nested blocks are chosen the same way.

item.title: Link the competency objects
item.description: Add the program's competency objects on the Expectations page and choose them in the competency object references of events and blocks.

item.title: Review the structure
item.description: The Document Graph shows blocks, events, competencies and levels with their references; the Curriculum Timeline shows the blocks by date and level; Document Lists shows the events as an editable table. Double-click an element to edit it.

item.title: Check the report
item.description: The Problems view lists what the schemas and the rules of the standard find: references to events or blocks that do not exist, dates outside the reporting period, events in no block. Rename an event or block identifier with Edit > Rename Identifier (Alt+Shift+R) to update its references too.
item.onCompletion: The report is ready to save and submit. Keep it in a project shared with Git to see what changed between reporting periods (Compare With).
